description: SmartFlow Portal brings client projects into ChatGPT. View project plans and milestones, follow actions waiting on you, review invoices, and keep delivery moving. Authorized SmartFlow administrators can also manage organizations, plans, client submissions, time entries, and billing workflows, with access enforced from the signed-in user's role and organization scope.

defaultPrompt: Show the plan of my project and what is waiting on me.
List the invoices issued to my organization.
